name: Pingree Day Camp
description_short: A general day camp on Pingree School's 100-acre campus in South Hamilton, MA, for children entering pre-K through grade 8, plus a counselor-in-training program. Campers are grouped by grade and do art, swim lessons, sports, games and elective periods. Snack and lunch are included.
refund_policy_summary: Summer 2026 terms: full refund if you cancel January 1–February 28; full refund minus a $100 deposit per cancelled week for March 1–28; no refund from April 1 without a doctor's note. No prorated rates for missed days except in extenuating circumstances.
special_needs_notes: Food allergies: Pingree School's lunch staff and the camp health care supervisor handle allergies, and campers may not bring any food. Little Wonders campers must be toilet trained.
swim_waterfront_notes: The camp has a swimming pool and a private pond used for kayaking. Swim lessons are part of the daily schedule. Many staff are certified lifeguards and water safety instructors.

warnings: The page shows the summer 2026 season, which has already ended (today is 2026-10-13). No 2027 dates, prices or policies are posted yet.

Session and week prices in this listing are the Little Wonders & Rainbows (pre-K–grade 7) rates. Other programs cost more or less: Adventurers (grade 8) runs weeks 3–8 only, at $750 per week or $1,350 per session. Counselors-in-Training pay $475 per week ($400 for week 2).

The tuition table has inconsistencies. Session 1 notes 'No camp on July 4', but elsewhere the closed day is July 3. Week 2 is $675 for Little Wonders & Rainbows, the same as a full week, even though it is shorter. Session 1 ($1,075) costs less than two single weeks.
Rainbows is described as grades 1–5, but the tuition table says 'Pre-K–Grade 7' and Explorers (grades 6–7) is mentioned separately.
